# Stock compact-bar (reference)

This is the **pristine, unmodified** zellij `compact-bar` plugin source from the
`v0.45.0` release of the upstream project — it is the baseline this repo's `src/` was
forked from and modified on top of.

- Upstream repo: https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij
- Path in upstream: `default-plugins/compact-bar/src/`
- Release: v0.45.0

Use it to diff against our customized `src/` to see exactly what changed:

```bash
diff -r vendor/compact-bar-stock/src src/
```

> This directory is a read-only snapshot for reference only. It is **not** used to build
> the plugin, and it may be older than upstream's `main` branch.
